bugs.title: Apollo GraphQL error: 'currencyCode' field missing from LineItemType fragment
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Sign in as org user. 2. Navigate to any product page. 3. Click Add to Cart. 4. Observe browser console.
bugs.expected: No GraphQL errors when adding items to cart
bugs.actual: ApolloError: Cannot query field 'currencyCode' on type 'LineItemType' — fires on addItem mutation response processing
consoleErrors: ApolloError: Cannot query field "currencyCode" on type "LineItemType"
bugs.notes: Pre-existing fragment/schema mismatch. Surfaced during SMK-008 (add to cart flow). Cart operations complete successfully — error is in client-side Apollo fragment cache, not a blocking server error.

bugs.title: ApolloError NetworkError + 'server experiencing technical issues' toast on /checkout/completed after Skyflow order
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Complete a Skyflow saved card checkout (CVV entry, Fixed Rate Ground). 2. Order confirmation page /checkout/completed loads. 3. Observe toast notification and console.
bugs.expected: No errors on order confirmation page; clean post-order state
bugs.actual: Toast: 'Apologies for the inconvenience. Our server is currently experiencing technical issues. Please try again later.' + ApolloError: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource — fires on a post-order background GraphQL request. Order CO260615-00023 was successfully created.
consoleErrors: ApolloError: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource.
bugs.notes: Order placed successfully (CO260615-00023). The error occurs on a subsequent background fetch (likely cart/notifications refresh) after order submission. The 'server experiencing technical issues' toast is misleading to end users as the order did succeed. Toast blocked the Logout button click requiring manual dismissal.
